description: six separate village objects: a wooden fence section, a wooden signpost with two arrows, a lamp post with a hanging lantern, a stone well with a small roof, two round hay bales, a wooden bench for a top-down 3/4 view fantasy action RPG, seen from above at an angle, soft shading lit from the upper left, a thin dark outline, rich natural colours, detailed modern pixel art; arranged in a 3 by 2 grid with wide empty space between them, every object whole, not touching the others or the picture edges; on a plain flat pure white background
